candidates.snippet: 1888: Studies Law in London - Gandhi traveled to London to study law, embarking on a significant period of personal and intellectual development. 1891: Begins Legal Practice in India - After returning to India, Gandhi began his legal practice, marking the start of his professional career and engagement with Indian society. 1910: Founds Tolstoy Farm - Gandhi established Tolstoy Farm, a communal living experiment and training center for activists, in South Africa. 1930: Leads Salt March - Gandhi led the Salt March, a significant act of nonviolent civil disobedience against British salt tax policy.
